BOTTOM LINE

WIDER CONTEXT
- November 2023: after Mohamed Almusibli, the director named to start in March 2024, signed two open letters on Gaza (one by more than 4,000 artists calling for a ceasefire, one in Artforum calling on cultural institutions to end their silence), Joël Thüring, a member of the Basel cantonal parliament for the right-wing Swiss People's Party (SVP), called him an "Israel hater" on X and called on the cantonal government to withdraw funding from the Kunsthalle unless the appointment was annulled (Swissinfo, 20 and 23 November 2023).

- The demand was aimed at the Kunsthalle's public funder and concerned the director of the space itself, which links it to the Kunsthalle.

BOTTOM LINE
The money behind the Kunsthalle is the Canton Basel-Stadt subsidy of CHF 950,000 a year (32% of income in the canton's 2023 model budget), third-party funding of about 30%, property rent of about 22% and member dues, and no flagged industry was found. The weak point is political pressure, not funding: an SVP parliamentarian demanded in November 2023 that the canton withdraw the subsidy over the director's open letters, and no cut is reported. Third-party funders are not named in the pages and documents opened.
